description: This file declares utility functions and data structures for interacting with NetworkManager via GDBus in a Linux environment, including device and access point info, and network configuration management.

classes.name: GnomeUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for network device and connection management using GDBus.

methods.name: getDeviceByIpIface
methods.description: Retrieves device path by IP interface name.

methods.name: getApDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of a WiFi access point.

methods.name: getConnectionPaths
methods.description: Gets list of connection paths.

methods.name: getWifiConnectionPaths
methods.description: Gets WiFi connection paths for a device.

methods.name: getDevicePropertiesByPath
methods.description: Retrieves device properties given a device path.

methods.name: getDeviceInfoByIfname
methods.description: Gets device info by interface name.

methods.name: getCachedPropertyU
methods.description: Gets cached unsigned integer property from GDBusProxy.

methods.name: getCachedPropertyBoolean
methods.description: Gets cached boolean property from GDBusProxy.

methods.name: getIPv4AddrFromIPv4ConfigProxy
methods.description: Extracts IPv4 address and prefix from IPv4 config proxy.

methods.name: getIPv6AddrFromIPv6ConfigProxy
methods.description: Extracts IPv6 address and prefix from IPv6 config proxy.

methods.name: activateConnection
methods.description: Activates a network connection profile on a device.

methods.name: getSettingsConnectionPath
methods.description: Retrieves connection path for a given interface.

methods.name: ip4StrToNBO
methods.description: Converts IPv4 string to network byte order integer.

methods.name: ip6StrToNBO
methods.description: Converts IPv6 string to byte array.

methods.name: ip4ToString
methods.description: Converts IPv4 integer to string.

methods.name: ip6ToString
methods.description: Converts IPv6 byte array to string.

methods.name: addGvariantToBuilder
methods.description: Adds GVariant data to a builder, excluding route metrics if specified.

methods.name: convertSsidInfoToJsonObject
methods.description: Converts WiFi SSID info to JSON object.

methods.name: convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts percentage to WiFi signal strength.

methods.name: wifiSecurityModeFromApFlags
methods.description: Determines WiFi security mode from flags.

methods.name: getWifiIfname
methods.description: Returns WiFi interface name.

methods.name: getEthIfname
methods.description: Returns Ethernet interface name.

methods.name: writePersistentHostname
methods.description: Writes hostname to persistent storage.

methods.name: readPersistentHostname
methods.description: Reads hostname from persistent storage.
